name: barbara-zero
description: Jogo infantil educativo de casinha, decoração e leitura.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:cap && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build:cap && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build:cap && npx cap add ios
scripts.build:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:aab: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew bundleRelease
